label: Morning intel
prompt: Run my morning brief: today's calendar, anything that needs a decision, and today's training session from the triathlon plan with the week number and phase. Do not try to write any file — nothing is writable here. Print the finished styled page inline in a ```html fenced block instead; the runner saves it into the vault. For the Fraunces headline @font-face, write the literal placeholder token __FRAUNCES_WOFF2__ as the src url — like src: url(__FRAUNCES_WOFF2__) format('woff2') — and do not base64 anything yourself; the runner substitutes the real font bytes. Do not fall back to Georgia. Skip the Playwright screenshot verification: node and Chromium are not installed on this machine, and that check is not a reason to withhold the page. After the page, emit one more fenced block, ```json, matching this shape exactly: {"decisions": [{"title": "...", "meta": "SHORT UPPERCASE QUALIFIER"}], "needs": [{"title": "...", "meta": "4h"}], "email": {"total": 0, "buckets": [{"label": "PARTN", "count": 0}, {"label": "LEADS", "count": 0}, {"label": "OPS", "count": 0}, {"label": "NEWS", "count": 0}, {"label": "NOISE", "count": 0}]}} — decisions are the items needing a decision, needs are unanswered items with an age like 4h or 3d, and email counts cover the last 24 hours. This block feeds the dashboard; emit it even if a list is empty.
